Reference image for the [[Jokes]] row on [[Slayn & Korpil Facilities]]: part of the body copy of a Trane advertisement for the XL 1200 air conditioner ("It's the one with the exclusive 10-year warranty."), with the lines "And, most important, it's made by Trane. And that means quality." outlined. The advertisement prints light text on a dark background; the crop is shown inverted (dark on light), enlarged and sharpened for legibility.

Source: ''Air Conditioning, Heating & Refrigeration News'', 6 April 1987 (1987 Statistical Panorama issue), scan at the [https://archive.org/details/micro_IA40706924_0238 Internet Archive] (item micro_IA40706924_0238, leaf 39).

License: Non-free. Fair-use rationale: a small crop of one advertisement, shown only to identify the real advertising line that the card's lore resembles, beside the card on [[Jokes]]. It cannot replace the original or harm its market.
